Default payout rail is Nessie fiat/mobile money; Solana is the auditable ledger for the insurer, opt-in for payees. Node is site-level, no per-worker identity or location tracking.
ethicist.crypto_verdict: Honest only as the insurer's public audit trail and cross-border settlement; for the payee it is a bolt-on, since SEWA paid through bank accounts and nobody at a market stall wants a devnet wallet, so say that out loud.
tracks_to_enter: Microsoft Built for the Real World
